content:
Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo, Apple has released a collection of new resources to help developers prepare for its first foldable iPhone. Here are the details.

Apple shares iPhone Duo resources with developers

Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo earlier today at its "Surprise and Shine" event. The device, Apple's first foldable phone, was announced alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

In addition to revealing the iPhone Duo to the public and sharing device assets on its Design Resources platform, Apple has also launched a dedicated page offering a number of resources to help developers prepare for this new foldable device.

These include two iPhone Duo Group Labs scheduled for September 16 and 17, as well as Q&A sessions focused on Photos and Camera, SwiftUI, and UIKit, with two sessions for each topic at different times, taking place on September 23.

Additionally, Apple will be hosting iPhone Duo workshops around the world, offering hands-on sessions for developers to optimise their apps and "explore adaptability across all screen sizes." These events will kick off later this month.

The "Get ready for iPhone Duo" page also lists upcoming tools and documentation, including Xcode 27.1 beta, "Designing for iPhone Duo," and "Preparing your app for iPhone Duo."

The page also lists the following six videos modelled after the WWDC session style:

  • Design for iPhone Duo
  • Prepare your app for iPhone Duo
  • Raise the bar with iPhone Duo
  • Strike a pose with adaptive layouts on iPhone Duo
  • Leverage multiple displays and scenes on iPhone Duo
  • Build a great camera experience for iPhone Duo

You can find the full collection of developer resources Apple has made available for the iPhone Duo here.
